messages:
Alex: quick sanity check — seeing recall@10 vary ~2.3% between runs when only changing RNG seed. anyone else?
Maria: which model/config?
Alex: redwood/vec-base-v2 fp16, no quant. microbatching(batch_size=16) + per-microbatch layernorm. seeds 42 vs 43.
Raj: paste command?
Alex: ```
python run_onboard_eval.py \
  --model redwood/vec-base-v2 \
  --seed 42 \
  --batch_size 16 \
  --microbatch 4 \
  --dataset semantic-holdout-1k \
  --metric recall@10
```
Ran twice seed=42 -> 0.781 / 0.783; seed=43 -> 0.759
Maria: did you pin deterministic flags (cudnn)?
Alex: no. reran with:
```
export PYTORCH_DETERMINISTIC=1
export CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8
```
seed42 0.782, seed43 0.760 (same gap)
Raj: maybe microbatch order or fp reductions.
Sophia: dataset shuffle? seed for dataloader?
Alex: shuffle=False. tried microbatch=1, gap shrank to ~0.4%.
Maria: per-microbatch norm + microbatching amplifies fp noise. verify accumulation dtype.
Raj: logs:
[run 4312345601] seed=42 recall@10=0.7821
[run 4312345602] seed=43 recall@10=0.7602
[run 4312345603] seed=42 microbatch=1 recall@10=0.7805
[run 4312345604] seed=43 microbatch=1 recall@10=0.7773
Alex: reducing microbatch reduces variance.
Sophia: propose two experiments: (A) accumulate embeddings in float32 before normalize; (B) remove per-microbatch layernorm and apply after full aggregation.
Maria: I'll run A/B on seeds 42/43 microbatch=4
dev-bot: CI queued: onboard-stability/4312345600 matrix seed=[42,43],acc=[f16,f32]
Alex: exp A results: seed42 0.7830 seed43 0.7778 (gap 0.53%)
Maria: exp B (global norm): seed42 0.7829 seed43 0.7811 (gap 0.22%)
Alex: global norm nearly removed gap. tradeoffs noted.
Maria: mitigation: switch to float32 accumulation and prefer global norm. update onboarding checklist.
Raj: runbook snippet:
```
- pin RNGs (model,numpy,torch)
- set PYTORCH_DETERMINISTIC=1 and CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG
- prefer float32 accumulation for microbatch reductions
- avoid per-microbatch layernorm when possible; apply after aggregation
- run seeds [42,43,101] and report stddev recall@k
```
Alex: updating eval PR with float32 accumulation. re-running full sweep.
Maria: filing ENG ticket for unit test on deterministic microbatch aggregation.
Sophia: add doc note on perf/cost tradeoffs for global vs microbatch norm.
Raj: filed ENG-1248. marking resolved.
Alex: resolved ✅
